title: EasyBookGuides
description: This plugin for paper allows server admins to create in-book guides without giving users any items. Also this plugin allows dynamic command generation, seamless book editing and easy configuration.
body:
# EasyBookGuides 📚
**Developed by chroma** The ultimate seamless virtual guide solution for modern Minecraft networks.

Tired of clunky configurations, broken timing macros, or plugins that force ugly physical books into your players' inventories? **EasyBookGuides** is a lightweight, high-performance Paper plugin built explicitly for modern Minecraft versions (including **1.21.11**).

It lets you create completely custom commands (like 
```/guide```, ```/rules```, or ```/discordbook```) that instantly open beautiful virtual book screens for players. Because it utilizes native packet-level data streams, it operates with **zero inventory interference**-it will never drop an item, overwrite a player's hand, or clutter hotbars.

## ✨ Features
**In-Game Creation & Editing:** Write, design, and update your guides directly in-game using vanilla Books & Quills. No formatting headaches or messy configuration files.

**Instant Client Autofill Syncing:** Linked shortcut commands are injected natively into the server's command map. They light up green/white and autocomplete in the chat bar instantly without requiring server reboots or player relogs.

**Separation of Data:** Clean, organized database management. Pages and layouts live in books.yml, while active shortcut bindings live in activecommands.yml.

**Zero Inventory Footprint:** Uses native Adventure component packet execution to open interfaces out of thin air. Completely safe from duplication glitches, armor-slot overwrites, or item loss.

## 🛠️ Command Reference

```/bookcmd list``` - Displays a clean ledger of all stored book IDs, titles, and their live command mappings.

```/bookcmd save <id>``` - Copies the exact pages, title, and author of the book in your hand directly into the database.

```/bookcmd edit <id>``` - Spawns an editable copy of a stored guide into your inventory so you can make quick updates.

```/bookcmd link <id> <command>``` - Binds a custom slash command shortcut to your guide and instantly pushes it to player tab-completion grids.

```/bookcmd delete <id>``` - Permanently flushes a book ID and strips its associated shortcuts safely from the server.
